__provenance__.statement: THIS FILE IS SYNTHESISED FROM A DOCUMENT AND IS NOT A CAPTURE. It was written by reading docs/opnsense-api-survey.md, section Push sources (S10, which cites opnsense/src stable/26.7's netflow_v9.c), and RFC 3954, never by recording what a firewall sent. Do not treat this file as evidence; replace it with recorded datagrams rewritten under X1 once LV-NF has run.
__provenance__.survey_section: Push sources: remote syslog and NetFlow export, read from source for push sources

__provenance__.why_these_values: One v9 datagram holding the template and one TCP record: exported at uptime 100 s, the flow from uptime 40 s to 95 s, input index 13, output index 14, 10 packets of 14 200 octets. No version element, as S10 says: the version is read from the addresses.
__provenance__.example_values_are_not_a_network: Every address is a synthesised example value, documentation addresses (RFC 5737).
